label.context: Name of a widget on the Add screen (tab above the cards, and a switch in Settings): donut chart of this month's spending by category.

help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Where it goes' switch.

leftOut.context: Add screen > 'Where it goes' widget: categories left out of the chart (like rent) with what they cost, e.g. 'Rent 2,500 zł · Bills 300 zł'.

label.context: Name of an Add screen widget: spending so far against an even spread of the month's limits.

help.message: Spending so far against an even spread of the limits.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Pace' switch.

soFar.context: Add screen > Pace widget: sentence above the chart when there's no projection yet.

over.message: At this rate about {amount} over the limits by the end of the month.
over.context: Add screen > Pace widget: the month is projected to go over the limits by {amount}.

under.message: On course for {projected}, {amount} under the limits.
under.context: Add screen > Pace widget: the month is projected to end at {projected}, {amount} below the limits.

label.context: Name of an Add screen widget: the list of budget warnings.

help.message: Categories close to or over their limit.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Warnings' switch.

empty.message: All good: nothing close to a limit.
empty.context: Add screen > Warnings widget when there are no warnings.

label.context: Name of an Add screen widget: categories up or down compared with the same days of last month. Short.

help.message: Categories up or down on the same days last month.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Vs last month' switch.

empty.message: Nothing from last month to compare with.
empty.context: Add screen > Vs last month widget when last month has no spending.

same.one: Same as the first day of {month}.
same.other: Same as the first {count} days of {month}.
same.context: Add screen > Vs last month widget: spending equals the same days of last month. {count} days, {month} short month name (e.g. 'Aug').

more.one: {amount} more than the first day of {month}.
more.other: {amount} more than the first {count} days of {month}.
more.context: Add screen > Vs last month widget: this month so far costs {amount} more than the same {count} days of last month ({month}, short name).

less.one: {amount} less than the first day of {month}.
less.other: {amount} less than the first {count} days of {month}.
less.context: Add screen > Vs last month widget: this month so far costs {amount} less than the same {count} days of last month ({month}, short name).

label.context: Name of an Add screen widget: what's left of the income at the end of the month.

help.message: What’s left of the income at the end of the month.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Forecast' switch.

label.context: Name of an Add screen widget: this month's spending split between the people.

help.message: This month split between everyone in the budget.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Who paid' switch.

label.context: Name of an Add screen widget: progress of each savings goal.

help.message: How far each savings goal is.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Goals' switch.

empty.message: No goals yet. Add one in the Savings tab.
empty.context: Add screen > Goals widget when there are no savings goals.

label.context: Name of an Add screen widget: spending day by day over the last week.

help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the 'Last 7 days' switch.

summary.context: Add screen > Last 7 days widget: total spent over the week.

summaryWithLimit.message: {amount} in the last 7 days, {share} would be the limits' share.
summaryWithLimit.context: Add screen > Last 7 days widget: {amount} spent over the week; {share} is what the monthly limits allow for 7 days.

chartLabel.context: Accessible label of the bar chart in the Last 7 days widget.

nothingSpent.context: Add screen widgets (donut, who paid) when nothing has been spent this month.

label.context: Name of a widget on the Add screen (tab above the cards, and a switch in Settings): this month's three biggest spending categories.

help.message: The three biggest categories against what they usually cost.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the switch of the 'Top 3' widget.

label.context: Name of a widget on the Add screen (tab above the cards, and a switch in Settings): where this month's income went: kinds of spending, savings, investments, what's left.

help.message: Where this month's pay went: spending, bills, debts, savings.
help.context: Settings > Widgets: description under the switch of the 'Pay' widget.
